definitions.full: H8430. Toach תּוֺחַ proper name, masculine ancestor of Samuel 1Chr 6:19 [Levite !]; Θειε , Θοουε , ᵐ5 L Νααθ ; || תֹּ֫חוּ 1Sam 1:1 ; Θοκε , Θοου , ᵐ5 L Θωε . תּוֺחֶ֫לֶת see יחל . תּוֺךְ injury , see תֹּךְ below תכך .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to depress; humble ;

occurrences.englishText: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ households.
